spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (श्मीलति)
1 To wink, to contract the eyelids.
2 To twinkle.

r. 1st cl. (स्मीलति)
To wink, to twinkle, to close or contract like the eyelids.

n. (-नं)
Winking, twinkling.
E.
श्मील, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Winked, blinked.
n. (-तं)
A wink, winking.
E.
श्मील to wink, क्त aff.

r. 1st cl. (स्मयते)
To smile.
r. 10th cl. (स्नाययते)
To disrespect:
with वि prefixed,
to surprise or astonish.

r. 10th cl. (स्माययते)
To slight.
r. 1st cl. (स्मयते)
To smile. Also ष्मिङ्.

r. 10th cl. (स्मेटयति)
To slight, to disregard, to disrespect.

Blown, (as a flower.)
n. (-तं)
A smile, a gentle laugh.
E.
ष्मि to smile, aff. क्त.

f. (-दृक्)
A handsome woman.
E.
स्मित, and दृश् the eye.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Smiling, laughing.
E.
स्मित, and शालिन् having.
